title: Grade 2 Math — Thu, May 28
description: 2D Shapes — Day 4 of 5: Drawing and sorting shapes
subject: mathematics

questions.question: Sort into groups: Circle, Square, Triangle, Rectangle, Pentagon. Which group has exactly 4 sides?
questions.explanation: Square (4 sides) and Rectangle (4 sides) both have exactly 4 sides.

questions.question: Sort: which shapes have FEWER than 4 sides?
questions.explanation: Circle has 0 sides and Triangle has 3 sides — both fewer than 4.

questions.question: How many triangles make a square if you cut it diagonally?
questions.explanation: If you cut a square diagonally from corner to corner, you get 2 triangles.

questions.question: Which shapes have MORE than 4 sides?
questions.explanation: Pentagon (5 sides) and Hexagon (6 sides) both have more than 4 sides.

questions.question: If you fold a rectangle in half, what shape do you get?
questions.explanation: Folding a rectangle gives you a smaller rectangle (or a square if you start with a square).

questions.question: How many squares can you make from a bigger square by cutting it into 4 equal parts?
questions.explanation: Cutting a square into 4 equal parts gives 4 smaller squares!

questions.question: A shape with 3 sides and 3 corners is called a ___.
questions.explanation: Any shape with exactly 3 sides and 3 corners is a triangle.

questions.question: Count: 2 triangles + 1 square = how many corners in total?
questions.explanation: 2 triangles × 3 corners = 6 corners. 1 square = 4 corners. 6 + 4 = 10 corners.

questions.question: Which shape is BOTH a rectangle AND has all equal sides?
questions.explanation: A square is a special rectangle where all 4 sides are equal. Every square is a rectangle, but not every rectangle is a square.

questions.question: How many corners do 3 rectangles have in total?
If a shape has 6 corners, how many sides does it have?
questions.explanation: Any polygon has the same number of sides as corners. 6 corners = 6 sides = hexagon.

questions.question: What shape do you get when you put 2 squares side by side?
questions.explanation: Two squares side by side make a rectangle — it is now wider than it is tall.

questions.question: Sort: which shapes have curved edges?
questions.explanation: Of the common shapes, only a circle has a curved edge (no straight sides).

questions.question: How many triangles do you need to make a hexagon?
questions.explanation: A regular hexagon can be divided into 6 equal triangles from the center.

questions.question: Which shapes are quadrilaterals (4-sided shapes)?
questions.explanation: Quadrilateral means 4 sides. Square and Rectangle are both quadrilaterals.
